responsibility: This definition module declares the runtime interrupt-vector interface used with the COROUTINES support library. It belongs to the coroutine/event subsystem and exports constructors for input-, output-, and time-based interrupt sources, facilities to arm and query timers, attach user pointers, include or exclude vectors from dispatching, and a Listen routine that waits for pending events above a protection priority and invokes a dispatch callback.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public declaration side of the RTint pair: it names the vector-creation, timer, inclusion, and Listen routines for coroutine clients, while RTint.mod implements the actual vector records, pending queues, semaphore locking, and select-based waiting.
